SECOND LAYER, found only by running the fixed generators. With roots resolving, three of the four reached their next failure and exposed a defect the exit-2 error had been hiding: CreatureSpeciesGen and CreatureBuildPlanGen derived their OUTPUT root from the TUNING root's parent, which was valid only while tuning and the generated corpus shared one data/ directory. After the split tuning is in gk-core and the corpus is in the gk-data pack, so the generator compared 904 species against a gk-core/data/generated/creatures that does not exist and reported every one stale. Both now derive the output from seedRoot instead, which yields <content>/data in BOTH layouts because seedRoot is <content>/data/seed/creatures/species in each. With that, both report --check clean, 904 species byte-identical against the real gk-data corpus. A wrong error message hid a wrong path: the first failure said 'could not locate data/seed', which reads like a missing input and sent the work toward root discovery when the real second defect was an output path derived from the wrong root.
